model_interpretation.claim: Hoisting the per-call half-dimensions, aspect ratio, and subsample-count conversion out of the scalar primary-sample loops may remove repeated invariant work while preserving the order and values of the per-sample arithmetic. The compiler may already perform these hoists, so any benefit must be measured.

items.subject: Isolated scalar primary-ray and pixel-output experiments
items.objective: Optimize only the scalar primary-ray/per-pixel path in src/candidate.cpp, leaving the ambient-occlusion ray-generation/intersection kernel, RNG sequence, and thread scheduling unchanged. Measure invariant hoisting and local scalar accumulation/write-once changes separately against the original, then measure their combination; do not assume combined gains are additive. Preserve geometry and all primary samples, and check any rounding changes against the required RMSE and absolute-mean thresholds. Run all official correctness cases and repeated timings at each performance configuration so the result remains useful when considered for integration with the other tracks.
